item.title: Treesa-Gayatri end India’s 15-year wait, assure Badminton World Championships medal
item.summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand secured a World Championships medal. They achieved this after a comeback victory in the women's doubles quarterfinals. This guarantees the unseeded Indian pair at least a bronze medal. Their achievement marks the country's first medal in this event since 2011. The pair has shown strong progress and resilience throughout their career.
